input.question: AskHistorians Podcast 077 - The End of World War One in the Middle East, Part 2
input.ground_truth: Oh, excellent. I really enjoyed Part 1, so I'll listen to this on the drive to work tomorrow. I'll leave my questions about the topic itself until I've listened to both parts, but on a related note, /u/CptBuck I was wondering if you had noticed a difference between Arab studies in the US and the UK. Was there a difference in mainstream views, approaches, and thinking between the two countries? It always seemed to me that the way the Foreign Office and the State Department approached things displayed a divergent view of Arab states, and how to deal with them, and I wondered if that was reflective of each countries universities.
